description: This file contains server-side logic for Point of Sale (POS) operations in an ERP system, including item search, retrieval, and customer info management.

methods.name: search_by_term
methods.description: Searches for an item by barcode, serial, or batch number, and retrieves item details including stock and price info.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves a list of items based on search criteria, item group, and POS profile, with stock and price details.

methods.name: search_for_serial_or_batch_or_barcode_number
methods.description: Searches for an item by barcode, serial number, or batch number.

methods.name: filter_service_items
methods.description: Filters out non-stock items and product bundles from item list.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for item search based on search term.

methods.name: add_search_fields_condition
methods.description: Adds additional search conditions based on configured POS search fields.

methods.name: get_item_group_condition
methods.description: Generates SQL condition for item group filtering based on POS profile.

methods.name: item_group_query
methods.description: Provides a list of item groups matching search term and POS profile.

methods.name: check_opening_entry
methods.description: Checks for existing POS opening entries for a user.

methods.name: create_opening_voucher
methods.description: Creates a new POS opening entry with balance details.

methods.name: get_past_order_list
methods.description: Retrieves past POS invoices based on search term and status.

methods.name: set_customer_info
methods.description: Sets customer loyalty program, email, or mobile number, creating contact if necessary.
